findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "swift-ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_responses · Private data: post_responses, post_messages, post_generateContent · Public sink: post_chat_completions, post_responses, post_messages, post_generateContent, post_audio_speech, post_embeddings, post_moderations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_responses · Private data: post_responses, post_messages, post_generateContent · Public sink: post_chat_completions, post_responses, post_messages, post_generateContent, post_audio_speech, post_embeddings, post_moderations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
